metrics.name: Book Equity Reported
metrics.definition: Best available reported equity attributable to the parent before canonical preferred-equity adjustments.

formula.expression: COALESCE(stockholders_equity, common_equity, total_equity - COALESCE(noncontrolling_interest, 0), total_assets - total_liabilities - COALESCE(noncontrolling_interest, 0) - COALESCE(temporary_equity, 0))

fallback_rules: Prefer a compatible direct stockholders-equity fact, then direct common equity, then total equity less noncontrolling interest.
Use the assets-minus-liabilities reconstruction only when direct parent-equity facts are absent and temporary and noncontrolling interests are resolved.

metrics.name: Book Equity Common
metrics.definition: Book equity attributable to common shareholders after permanent and redeemable preferred claims.
fallback_rules: Subtract each compatible preferred-equity class exactly once; valid absence may be treated as zero.
Do not subtract preferred equity when the selected book_equity_reported source is explicitly common-only.

metrics.name: Book Equity Fama French
metrics.definition: Fama-French-style book equity: parent stockholders' equity plus compatible deferred-tax balance, less preferred equity.
fallback_rules: Use deferred-tax liabilities only when separately reported on a compatible consolidated basis; otherwise omit the adjustment and record that fallback.
Apply the preferred-equity hierarchy once and retain the selected components in formula lineage.

metrics.name: Tangible Common Equity
metrics.definition: Common book equity less goodwill and identifiable intangible assets.
fallback_rules: Calculate only when all required inputs pass their formula QC thresholds and satisfy every compatibility constraint.
If a required compatible input is absent, publish no value; do not impute or cross accounting bases.

metrics.name: Gross Profitability
metrics.definition: Gross profit divided by average total assets for the compatible measurement interval.
fallback_rules: Calculate only when all required inputs pass their formula QC thresholds and satisfy every compatibility constraint.
If a required compatible input is absent, publish no value; do not impute or cross accounting bases.

metrics.name: Operating Profitability

fallback_rules: Publish only when compatible common-shareholder net income is positive and nonzero.
Do not substitute total distributions or market-value payout measures for this accounting payout ratio.

metrics.name: EBITDA Reported
metrics.definition: EBITDA explicitly reported by the issuer under its stated non-GAAP definition, without canonical reconstruction or adjustment.
fallback_rules: Use only an explicitly reported issuer value with its definition and reconciliation provenance.
Never substitute ebitda_reconstructed or ebitda_before_stock_comp when a reported value is absent.

metrics.name: EBITDA Reconstructed
metrics.definition: Canonical reconstruction of EBITDA from operating income plus compatible depreciation and amortization expense.
fallback_rules: Prefer combined depreciation_and_amortization; otherwise require both separate depreciation and amortization inputs.
Never substitute ebitda_reported, and publish no reconstruction when compatible depreciation and amortization are unavailable.

metrics.name: EBITDA Before Stock Comp
metrics.definition: Reconstructed EBITDA before stock-based compensation expense.
fallback_rules: Require canonical reconstructed EBITDA and compatible stock-based compensation for the same period.
Never substitute an issuer-reported adjusted EBITDA whose adjustment set is not identical.
